title: BrightPath Standup - Course Builder Drag and Drop

transcript.speaker: Grace Eze
transcript.text: Morning team. Oliver, where are we on the drag-and-drop course builder?

transcript.speaker: Oliver Bennett
transcript.text: Reordering lessons within a module works now. Cross-module drag is trickier - the state management gets messy when a lesson moves to a different module's progress tracking.

transcript.speaker: Grace Eze
transcript.text: How much longer for cross-module drag?

transcript.speaker: Oliver Bennett
transcript.text: Probably two more days if nothing else comes up.

transcript.speaker: Grace Eze
transcript.text: Okay, let's timebox it - if it's not working by Thursday, we ship with same-module reordering only for this release and follow up with cross-module in the next sprint.

transcript.speaker: Fatima Siddiqui
transcript.text: That works for me design-wise, the drag handle looks the same either way.

transcript.speaker: Grace Eze
transcript.text: Fatima, how are the empty-state illustrations coming along?

transcript.speaker: Fatima Siddiqui
transcript.text: Done, I uploaded three variants to the shared drive this morning. I need someone to pick one before Friday's release.

transcript.speaker: Grace Eze
transcript.text: I'll review them today and pick one by end of day.

transcript.speaker: Oliver Bennett
transcript.text: One thing I want to flag - should we show a confirmation dialog before a drag-and-drop reorder saves, or save instantly like it does now? A couple of beta testers accidentally reordered lessons and didn't notice.

transcript.speaker: Grace Eze
transcript.text: Good catch, I don't want to add friction with a dialog on every drag, but let's think about an undo toast instead. Let me check with Fatima on what that would look like.

summary_key_points: Same-module lesson reordering is working; cross-module drag is more complex
Cross-module drag will be timeboxed to Thursday or deferred to the next sprint
Empty-state illustrations are done and awaiting a final pick
Beta testers accidentally reordered lessons without noticing, raising a UX concern

action_items.task: Review the empty-state illustration variants and pick one by end of day
Continue work on cross-module drag and drop, timeboxed to Thursday

decisions: Ship with same-module reordering only if cross-module drag isn't ready by Thursday, and follow up next sprint
open_questions: Should reordering show an undo toast instead of saving instantly, to avoid accidental reorders?
